control_point: An identified population of reporting errors is remediated and the relevant competent authority is notified under the applicable transaction-reporting regime.

citations.source_name: Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 (EMIR), Article 9 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2019/834 (EMIR REFIT)
17 CFR Part 45 - Swap Data Recordkeeping and Reporting Requirements

consequence_anchor.public_source: Competent-authority enforcement under MiFIR Article 35, EMIR Article 21 and CFTC Part 45; published enforcement for late or incomplete remediation of reporting errors
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: published penalties in the low- to mid-million-euro range and comparable CFTC civil monetary penalties; escalation where the authority is not notified within required timeframes

commonality_rationale: All transaction-reporting regimes require firms to correct errors and omissions once discovered and to notify the regulator where required; the remediation workflow is a shared operational checkpoint across EU and US swap and securities reporting obligations.
